newsitem.title: USA: Cobra Electronics president Kalov to retire.
newsitem.headline: Cobra Electronics president Kalov to retire.

text.p: Cobra Electronics Corp said Monday its President and Chief Executive Officer Jerry Kalov will retire effective January 1, 1998.

The company also said James Bazet will join the company as executive vice president and chief operating officer on July 28, 1997 and assume the duties of president and chief executive officer on January 1, 1998.
As part of the transition process, Kalov also immediately assumes the additional post of vice chairman of the board of directors.
Kalov will continue to serve in that capacity after his retirement, focusing on the development of strategic business opportunities for the company.

"The company's continued progress, as well as our expectations that 1997 will be an even more successful year than 1996, make this the right time for me to turn over day-to-day operations of the company," said Kalov in a statement.

Bazet has managed companies in both the consumer electronics and housewares industries. Before joining Cobra, he was president and chief executive officer of Ryobi Motor Products Floor Care Division, which marketed products under the Ryobi, Singer and Kenmore brand names.
Cobra Electronics designs and markets consumer electronics products including CB radios, cordless telephones and telephone answering systems.
